description: Analyze fine-grained performance data provided by the MicroProfiler through the LibMP Luau module. Use it to investigate CPU and GPU bottlenecks, identify the causes of frame-time spikes, and analyze memory allocations by subsystem.

results.query: A player sent me a MicroProfiler dump (.gprx) from their phone. Can you work out what causes their frame spikes?
Write a LibMP snippet for the Studio command bar that returns the 10 slowest frames in slot 1 and the top scopes in each.
With LibMP, how do I read the Luau heap counter's value for every frame in a capture?
The MicroProfiler shows GPU time almost equal to the frame time. Does that mean we're GPU-bound, and how do I check properly?
Capture MicroProfiler data on the server during a playtest and tell me which scope dominates its frame time.
Break down client memory by subsystem from the MicroProfiler's counters and tell me which one keeps growing.
Every time I run my LibMP analysis script, LibMP.GetMemUsed() goes up. What am I leaking?
In the MicroProfiler there's a wide updateInvalidatedFastClusters scope every few seconds. What is it and what triggers it?
Find the frames in my MicroProfiler capture where physicsStepped takes more than 5 ms, and show what else runs in those frames.
Frame time spikes to 200 ms every few seconds in a Studio playtest. Profile it and find what's causing the spikes.
Design a pet follow system that still runs well with 200 pets in the server.
The Script Profiler says my pathfinding function takes 40% of script time. How do I make it faster?
Should I pool my bullet parts or create and destroy them each shot?
My Vide inventory list with 400 rows stalls for a frame every time it opens. Optimize it.
A Chrome DevTools performance trace of my React app shows long tasks. How do I read it?
Unity's Profiler shows GC.Alloc spikes every frame in my C# player controller. How do I get rid of them?
How many bytes does a RemoteEvent call with a Vector3 cost, and how do I cut my remote traffic?
Add debug.profilebegin and debug.profileend labels around each system's update loop.
Our creator dashboard says average FPS on mobile dropped last week. Was it the update we shipped?
The Luau heap snapshot in the Developer Console lists many unique references to Parts. How do I find which script holds them?
